cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(DbgAtlasInteractionFixture LANGUAGES CXX)
if(NOT MSVC)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "MSVC is required")
endif()
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
add_executable(probe_target target.cpp)
add_library(probe_extension SHARED extension.cpp)
foreach(target probe_target probe_extension)
  target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE /W4 /EHsc)
endforeach()
